rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for disguising or concealing something, especially feelings or opinions.

example.english: They often dissemble their true feelings in front of other people.
example.traditional: 佢喺人面前成日掩飾自己嘅真實感受。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 seng4 jat6 jim2 sik1 zi6 gei2 ge3 zan1 sat6 gam2 sau6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when something is deliberately kept out of sight, including keeping feelings or thoughts to oneself.

example.english: I don't want to dissemble by hiding my feelings.
example.traditional: 我唔想收埋自己嘅感受。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sau1 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6

rows.note: Use this when the dissembling involves pretending to be different or pretending not to feel or think something.

example.english: They dissemble by pretending to be completely unfazed even though they are clearly nervous.
example.traditional: 佢明明好緊張，仲要扮到若無其事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 ming4 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 zung6 jiu3 baan6 dou3 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6
